dashboard.settings.autoAcceptHelp: Orders are confirmed automatically. If the requested slot is full, the order moves to the next free slot. It confirms only when there is capacity. Orders with customer notes (e.g. an allergy) still need to be confirmed manually.
dashboard.settings.layoutHelp: How items are shown on the „Add order“ screen.
dashboard.settings.layoutTabsHelp: Shows one category at a time. Tap a category to switch. Best for longer menus, where every item stays in the same place.
dashboard.settings.layoutScrollHelp: Shows all items in one scrolling list, with a heading for each category. There are no category buttons — you move around by scrolling. Best for shorter menus, where you can see most of it at once.
dashboard.settings.paidStepHelp: Adds a „Confirm“ button when you add an order yourself, so you can send it now and take payment later.
dashboard.settings.takesCashHelp: Splits the payment button into „Cash“ and „Card“.
dashboard.settings.orderReadyHelp: Shows a „Mark as ready“ button on the orders screen. Kitchen screens (KDS) are set separately. Customers get an email whenever an order is marked as ready.
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptTitle: Remind me to add a pager
dashboard.settings.buzzerPromptHelp: Opens the pager grid as soon as you send an order, so the number appears on the board while the customer is still in front of you. When it is off you can still add a pager any time by tapping the order, but nothing will remind you. Useful where you hand out pagers, easily switched off where you don’t.
dashboard.settings.cardsHelp: Turn this off when there is a card problem and customers will order as usual and pay at the food truck. Orders keep arriving; only the card step stops.
dashboard.settings.cardsScope: This applies to your whole food truck, on every event, and stays off until you turn it back on.
dashboard.settings.soundsHelp: The on/off switch is on each screen; each device controls its own sound.
